caseNameFull: John McComish, Applicants v. Ken Bennett, Secretary of State of the State of Arizona

opinions.text: Application to vacate the stay, presented to Justice Kennedy, and by him referred to the Court, denied. Denial is without prejudice to a renewed application on June 1, 2010, or when the Court of Appeals has issued its decision on the merits of the case, whichever date is earlier.
